claims.statement: A finite n-element poset with maximum incomparability degree D has at most 1+n*2^D order ideals. Ideal-state forward/backward integer counts compute all incomparable-pair order counts with at most J*(D+1)*D pair-count additions after transitions are known, where J is the number of ideals.
For distinct elements of an n-element poset with N extensions, let M=sum(Rx-Ry), A=sum((Rx-Ry)^2+|Rx-Ry|). The integer condition (n+1)AN>=901(n+2)M^2 implies that pair is 1/3-balanced.

For all 346 three-chain offset matrices with off-diagonal thresholds 1..3, triangle inequalities and maximum interior incomparability degree <=7, at lengths m=5,8,12,20, the balance is at least 129561945/308807813.

The explicit width-three seven-thin 15-element offset poset with t=[[1,1,1],[2,1,2],[3,3,1]] has no incomparable pair whose ACPP Lemma 5.2 mean/variance lower-bound expression reaches 1/3, although its balance is 68022/148048.

Every equal-length positive constant-offset three-chain strip with diagonal 1, triangle inequalities and interior incomparability degree at most nine has balance at least 7/18 for every m>=1. The constant is sharp within this family, attained at m=3 by t=[[1,1,1],[3,1,1],[3,3,1]].

A finite poset partitioned into three chains with arbitrary unequal prefixes and an exact stationary threshold tail of degreeD has a final-three-position pair in[2/5,3/5] for sufficientD/R=7/11,8/12,9/14,10/14,11/14,12/14,13/14,14/14,15/14,16/14. No global degree bound; the pair may depend on the whole poset. Complete32079 matrices/5436 directed orbits, 979 independently checked replacement tables(893 fixed-pair,86 mixture),4457 unchanged pinned cones. Period-two degree7 tailsR>=12 retain[7/18,11/18] with local phase.

Sharp7/18 balance for every length of the complete7006-orbit (41584 labeled ordered pairs) period-two three-chain threshold family with entries1..3, diagonal1, stated cross-phase transitivity inequalities and interior incomparability degree<=7. Equality is the constant-pattern nine-point example with684 extensions and best smaller count266.

Proposed backward finite-state representation of aligned three-chain degree-seven posets with every level gap>=3 comparable and with no Zaguia very-good pair at finalized levels; no balance theorem or full graph classification is claimed.

For a finite poset, form F with edge x->y if D(x) subset D(y) and U(y) minus U(x) is a chain, or if U(y) subset U(x) and D(x) minus D(y) is a chain. A directed cycle in F implies existence of a1/3-balanced pair, possibly elsewhere in P. This is a sufficient criterion, not a claim that every nonchain has such a cycle.

There are arbitrarily large aligned three-chain posets with all level gaps>=3 comparable, maximum incomparability degree7, and acyclic C009 structural good-pair graph. Ordinal sums of an explicit12-element poset supply them. The displayed eight-element induced obstruction is balanced, with318 extensions and balance68/159.

For every positive3x3 threshold matrix with diagonal1, all triangle inequalities and D(t)<=16, every equal-length stationary three-chain P(t,m) has balance>=2/5 except the single nine-point type R of balance7/18. Complete32079 matrices,2902 symmetry orbits,882 exceptional labeled parameters at m3. Exact independent cones,950 finite alternates and19473 short cases checked;7/18 is sharp overall.

If a finite poset is partitioned into chains with prefix lengths p_a and R terminal points each, and T_a(0)<T_b(q_ab) whenever 0<=q_ab<R, let B=sum p_a and S=max_a sum_(b!=a)q_ab. Every ideal omitting a prefix point has size at most B+S-1. Hence rank cuts of size at least B+S clear all prefixes, without any global degree assumption.
For positive three-chain threshold matrices with diagonal1, triangle inequalities and d(t)<=D, the largest off-diagonal is at most floor(2D/3), sharply for every integer D>=2.

The literal finite inequality in Chen arXiv1709.05753v2 Proposition4.1 fails at k=1,i=j=5: P(5,5) has106 extensions, with a5 before b5 in69 and the opposite order in37, and37/106>(93-sqrt6697)/32. This does not refute limiting Theorem2.4.

Every finite poset on(r,a),0<=r<m,0<=a<3, whose three columns are chains, whose levels are antichains, whose relations increase level, in which every pair of points with level gap>=3 is comparable in increasing level order, and whose maximum incomparability degree is<=7, has uniform-linear-extension balance>=7/18.

The period-four threshold template(X,Y,Z,X) in the proof has maximum interior incomparability degree7, but its18-point/six-level prefix has degree6 and balance58150/149641<7/18. Every ordinal power of that finite prefix retains its balance and three-chain gap-three degree6 class. This refutes the stronger nonstationary/period-four7/18 variant, not T112.

For any finite poset P and marked subset A, the exact rank cutoff clearing A is G=max_(x in A)(|P|-|{y:x<y}|), or0 if A is empty. The bound G<=B+S of C012 is sharp for every positive triangular stationary w-chain tail matrix, with sufficiently long common tails and all B>=1 prefix points on a maximizing row chain.

Every nine-point poset of width3 and height3 has balance>=7/18; equality has exactly one isomorphism type R=[0,0,0,1,3,7,9,27,63] in strict predecessor masks. Outside that type the sharp lower bound is84/209, attained by a627-extension type. Complete independent generation and integer counting cover12791 fixed-label representatives.

Every twelve-point poset of width3,height4 has uniform-linear-extension balance>=3466/8587>2/5, sharply, with one equality isomorphism type having8587 extensions and maximal smaller count3466. Complete independent family check:401771 symmetry representatives,4795887 fixed-label orders; independent exact witness checks and all34650 chain interleavings verify sharpness.

For positive triangular wxw threshold tails, every normalized ideal state d with coordinate sum congruent to n modulo w is attainable at every total rank n>=S=max_a sum_(b!=a)t_ab. Thus at the uniform prefix-guard cut every phase-zero state with positive completion count is attainable; reachability pruning cannot remove a negative terminal-cone coordinate. Elementary method obstruction, no balanced-pair or novelty claim.

For arbitrary unequal prefixes on three chains and an exact terminal threshold pattern, a final-three-position pair has probability in[2/5,3/5] for t=[[1,1,1],[2,1,3],[7,7,1]],R>=16, and t=[[1,1,1],[2,1,2],[7,6,1]],R>=18. No global degree bound. Every mixture of each eleven-state conditional table has a balanced pair, although no fixed candidate pair works for all mixtures. All16 bias patterns per case have independently checked exact rational dual certificates.
